options.content:
### Dogpackapp · Enterprise Home

Use this page for **platform health, SLO, capacity risk and active incidents**. Open a detailed dashboard only after a KPI turns yellow or red.

| Area | Dashboard | When to open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host CPU / memory / disk / net | [Dogpackapp Resources](/d/rYdddlPWj) | Node hotspot or DOWN exporter |
| ECS CPU / memory / CloudWatch logs | [ECS CloudWatch](/d/dogpack-ecs-cloudwatch) | ECS gauge elevated |
| Docker / container logs | [Docker Container Logs](/d/dogpack-docker-logs) | Error log spike |
| PM2 application logs | [PM2 Application Logs](/d/dogpack-pm2-logs) | App exceptions |
| Alert routing | [Alert rules](/alerting/list) | Critical or warning count > 0 |

**How to read the command center:** green = healthy, yellow = approaching limit, red = action required. Default SLO is **99.9% availability over 24h**.
